mainEntity.name: How much does an Uber accident lawyer cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Uber accident lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the final settlement or court award. If your case is not successful, you typically owe no attorney fees. This arrangement allows injured individuals to pursue justice without worrying about immediate financial burdens. It's important to discuss the specific percentage and any potential litigation costs with your attorney during your initial consultation.
